units.source_text: 仅是火柴熄灭，学生似乎心里仍然感到不放心。

en.t: Even after the match had gone out, the student still seemed uneasy at heart.

units.source_text: 他又用鞋底小心地将扔在基石上的烟火踩了踩，

en.t: He carefully pressed the discarded firework on the foundation stone with the sole of his shoe again,

units.source_text: 然后愉快地抽起烟来，将被遗留下来的我的失望置于一旁，

en.t: then cheerfully began to smoke, leaving my abandoned disappointment aside,

units.source_text: 自已踱过了石桥，经过敕使门，

en.t: and he himself strolled across the stone bridge and passed through the Imperial Messenger Gate,

units.source_text: 悠然地出了在投下延伸着成排房屋的影子的大路上看得见的南门，走远了。

en.t: then leisurely went out through the South Gate visible from the broad road where the shadows of rows of houses stretched out, and disappeared into the distance.
